text.description_html:
Acorn KP1JP, Checkered Flag Stainless Steel Cabinet Knob

Acorn's Square Checkered Flag Stainless Steel Cabinet Knob is the perfect finishing touch to every room in the house, including the garage. The bold design is sure to make an impression in the kitchen, the bathroom, and even on the TV hutch. The natural stainless steel finish (similar to antique nickel or pewter) is perfect for not only modern decors but also more traditional styles, able to accent this contemporary material with a natural feel that just seems to belong in any setting.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality hand forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home.

Also Available: Round Checkered Flag Stainless Steel Cabinet Knob

Specifications of the Square Checkered Flag Stainless Steel Cabinet Knob:

  • Finish: Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Length: 1-1/4" square
  • Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
